column7: structural half of sso-first-federation-resurrect-001 (#2699): asserts resolveSSOUser persists through ClaimUserExternalIDIfUnset (a Where+Updates LocalStorage body with no Save and no Select("*")), never reaches UpdateUser or a bare Save, AND re-reads via storage.GetUser. The re-read is asserted separately on purpose -- it is the half that stops a session being minted for a deleted account, and a guard on the write shape alone would certify half a fix. Runs without a Postgres DSN
